By the product rule,

$$f'(x) = 2x \sin x + x^2 \cos x.$$

**(a)** Integrating by parts with $u = x$ and $dv = \cos x \, dx$,

$$\int_0^{\pi} x \cos x \, dx = \big[ x \sin x \big]_0^{\pi} - \int_0^{\pi} \sin x \, dx = -2.$$

**(b)** Integrating by parts with $u = x^2$ and $dv = \sin x \, dx$,

$$\int_0^{\pi} x^2 \sin x \, dx = \big[ -x^2 \cos x \big]_0^{\pi} + 2 \int_0^{\pi} x \cos x \, dx = \pi^2 - 4.$$

The characteristic polynomial is $\det(A - \lambda I) = (2 - \lambda)^2 - 1$, so $\lambda = 1$ or $\lambda = 3$, with eigenvectors $\begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ -1 \end{pmatrix}$ and $\begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}$.
